content: Stripe Node SDK (npm 'stripe') is at v22.6.1 as of Sept 2026. Best practice: create Checkout Sessions server-side via stripe.checkout.sessions.create() with mode:'subscription' and existing price IDs; never handle card data on your own origin. Always verify webhooks with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent (raw body + signing secret) rather than hand-rolled HMAC. Fulfill/update entitlement only from verified webhook events (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted), never from the client-side success redirect alone. Pin the Stripe API version explicitly in both the Dashboard and SDK init.
